What stops the rest: the front bumper corners (front_bumper_corner_l/r, i021/i020) are mapped by no view, so sponsor() can't place a partner on the bumper; the top view sees the splitter's upper face (i083) only at |w| 0.3-0.48, u 0.005-0.02, the bonnet hiding the rest, so it holds one 0.011-car-length mark per corner and no wordmark row; the sill strip (sill_strip_l/r) spans side v -0.02-0.04 and faces down; the mirror shells hold only a mark (Norvane's wordmark needs 0.0195 car lengths, more than the shell's 0.012); the right haunch has no place over the rear arch (lint crease 33-37% at u 0.765-0.87, v 0.79-0.81, and behind u 0.86 the haunch pin falls onto the letters); the rear deck is seen from above only at |w| 0.35-0.55, u 0.93-0.99, where the wing endplates cut wordmarks to 'xa' in rear34 (tried in sim run 20261021-211050 and dropped); marks under the door light panels read as part of the code lines (sim run 20261021-204520, dropped); behind the front arch the panel holds u 0.29-0.346 above the chevrons (left) and a two-mark column (right).
